summary: User-facing fluent API layer. BaseExpressionAPI and BooleanExpressionAPI wrap an AST node, compose Substrait and Mountainash-extension API builders via multiple inheritance, expose namespaces (.str, .dt, .name, .struct, .list, .cat, .geo) through NamespaceDescriptor, and overload Python operators. entrypoints.py provides the free functions (col, lit, when, coalesce, t_col, today, now, ...). The layer only builds backend-agnostic AST nodes; .compile(df) detects the backend and lowers via the visitor.
key_classes: BaseExpressionAPI — wraps an ExpressionNode, compile/collect plumbing, operator hooks
BooleanExpressionAPI — primary user class composing all builders and namespaces
NamespaceDescriptor — descriptor creating namespace builder instances (.str, .dt, ...)
DatetimeAPIBuilder / StringAPIBuilder / StructAPIBuilder / ListAPIBuilder / CategoricalAPIBuilder / GeospatialAPIBuilder — namespace-bound builders
Substrait*APIBuilder and MountainAsh*APIBuilder (api_builders/) — per-domain builders producing nodes
key_functions: coalesce(*exprs), greatest, least, *_horizontal — iterable/horizontal entry points
t_col(name, unknown=...) — ternary column with sentinel unknowns
extension_points: Add an api_bldr_* builder (substrait/ or extensions_mountainash/) implementing the matching prtcl_api_bldr_* protocol
Short aliases live only in extension builders (short-aliases principle)
lifecycle_notes: Six-step adding-operations process governs new methods
Recent git: 642480f8 (relations target= change touching shared files)
risks: Method-name collisions across many mixed-in builders (guarded by test_mro_method_collisions)
Public method signatures must stay in sync with protocols (test_signature_conformance)

evidence.detail: fluent-builder-pattern and three-layer-separation principles; substrait/ vs extensions_mountainash/ split
